title: A2A structured handoff response
description: Issue #2050: structured handoff response contract for POST /api/a2a. handoff_result is the machine-checkable outcome callers must inspect: ok = event created and dispatched; rejected = gate/policy/scene check intentionally blocked; failed = dispatch chain failed (no engine / event store failure / exception). source_seq echoes the effective source pipeline segment seq. Issue #2555: every skipped response also carries ok=false plus reason (human-readable Chinese why-skipped + next step) and detail (code-specific locator fields). skipped codes: task_cancelled (detail: issue_number/repository/status) | repo_mismatch (detail: issue_number/expected_repository/actual_repository) | target_scene_not_found / target_scene_missing_node (detail: target_node) | not_in_scene (detail: agent) | pr_subscription_a2a_disabled / sre_subscribed (detail: issue_number) | duplicate_a2a / duplicate_handoff (detail may be {}). Existing codes keep their meaning; new codes may be added, so skipped is intentionally not narrowed to an enum.

existing_status.description: Issue #2248: status of the existing event returned on an idempotency_key hit.

replayable.description: Issue #2248: true when the idempotency hit is a terminal event and may be replayed with force=true or a new round key.

ok.description: Issue #2555: false on every skipped response; existing ok paths keep their value.

reason.description: Issue #2555: human-readable Chinese explanation of why the handoff was skipped and what to do next. Never contains tokens, internal paths, scene ids or node lists.

detail.description: Issue #2555: code-specific locator fields; present (possibly {}) on every skipped response.
